caption: The drawing features a large brown eagle with its wings spread wide, positioned centrally. Behind the eagle are two blue triangular banners, each adorned with white stars, resembling segments of the American flag. Below the eagle and banners are red and white striped sections that also mimic the lower part of the American flag. At the top of the drawing, there is a curved blue banner with five brown stars on it. In each of the four corners of the drawing, there is a single large brown star. The background color is a light tan, and the composition is framed with a simple black border. The dominant colors in the drawing are brown, blue, red, white, and tan.
title: Hooked Rug
